correctness.rationale: The explicit 3x3 sweep B from three coordinate minimizations has vanishing first column. Gram nonzero 2x2 block obeys tr G=rho² S(rho), det G=rho^4(1+2rho²), det(I-G)=(rho-1)P(rho), S=2rho^4-6rho^3+7rho²-2rho+3, P=6rho^4+2rho²-rho-1. Independently checked exact coefficient polynomials against original verifier and SymPy. Psecond=72rho²+4>0, with endpoint signs yields exactly two real roots in SPD range. On P<=0, |rho|<2/3 gives detG<=272/729<1, ruling out both singular eigenvalues above one; on P>0 det(I-G)<0 gives one >1. At kappa=6, rho=5/8 gives ||B||~1.01807839 and rho=-5/13 gives ~0.85371231. Equalities at roots, all six update orders permutation-conjugate. The spectral eigenvalue modulus rho^(3/2) for positive rho is older and not the norm result.
